digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate material basis and fingerprinting
propositions: Boundary and trailing whitespace-only edits to no_file_impact_reason produce different fingerprints and incorrectly stale attestations, violating the whitespace-normalization invariant

material_basis() canonicalizes description but inserts no_file_impact_reason raw byte-for-byte when file_impact_scope is 'none', causing serialization to preserve cosmetic whitespace differences in the hash

normalize_reason parameter must be added to material_basis/material_fingerprint/current_material_fingerprint_impl to apply insignificant whitespace normalization to the reason field in current fingerprints only

_legacy_material_ok() must explicitly pass normalize_reason=False for all three historical candidates (pre-330c raw, post-330c/pre-2be7 checkbox-normalized, post-2be7/pre-fix canonical-description/raw-reason) to preserve byte-exact legacy fingerprint reproduction
interior whitespace changes and word changes to no_file_impact_reason must remain material and produce stale-material verdicts after the fix
